name: mastodon
description: Post a copy of each new post to your Mastodon account, linked back to your site
author: Symbiosis Lab

settings.label: Server

settings.label: Access token
settings.description: Made on your server under Preferences, Development, New application, with the scopes read:statuses and write:statuses.
